description: Lists authorized jobs scheduled for a business day, with bounded customer, schedule, status, and technician fields. Use to list today’s jobs in the connected business. Returns date, timezone, jobs, summary, scope.

date.description: Local business date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

name: jobs-today

date.description: Date used or returned by this tool.

jobs.description: Bounded jobs records returned by this tool.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

summary.description: Summary metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

timezone.description: Timezone used or returned by this tool.

title: Jobs Today Tool
